# Standard Gutenberg block coding

Source of truth (do not invent APIs):

- Tutorial: https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/getting-started/tutorial/
- `block.json`: https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/block-json/
- Wrapper: https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/block-wrapper/
- Edit/save: https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-edit-save/
- Metadata: https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-metadata/

Scaffold mental model: `@wordpress/create-block` `--variant=dynamic`.

TOCguide is a **Plugin Directory** plugin (admin UI + shortcode + auto-insert), not a Block Directory “block-only” plugin. Keep using Gutenberg APIs for the block itself; do not strip wp-admin to chase the Block Directory.

## Required shape

- `src/block.json` is the single source of truth (`apiVersion` 3). Register with `register_block_type( trailingslashit( TOCGUIDE_DIR ) . 'build' )` after `wp-scripts` copies metadata into `build/`.
- Dynamic block: `"render": "file:./render.php"` + `src/save.js` returns `null`. Never store a serialized outline in post content.
- `src/render.php` is output only — never declare functions there (it is included on every render).
- Editor: `useBlockProps()` on the wrapper. Front end: `get_block_wrapper_attributes()` so `supports` (color, spacing, typography, border, align, anchor, className) actually print.
- Front-end JS: `viewScript` as an ES module. Import `@wordpress/dom-ready`. No jQuery, no hand-rolled IIFE.
- `@wordpress/icons` is a **bundled** package (not a WordPress script handle). Keep it in `dependencies` if the editor imports it.
- Styles: `src/style.scss` (front + editor) and `src/editor.scss` (editor only), imported from `src/index.js`. Scope selectors under `.wp-block-tocguide-table-of-contents`.

## Editor UI conventions

- Block **Styles** live in `block.json` `"styles"` (Default / Minimal / Boxed / Underline / Card). Gutenberg adds `is-style-{name}` to `className`. Do **not** add a custom style `<SelectControl>` that duplicates the Styles panel.
- Keep legacy `stylePreset` as a `role: "local"` attribute for old content and the shortcode. PHP must prefer `is-style-*` from `className`, then fall back to `stylePreset`.
- Editable title: `RichText` on the canvas (`identifier="title"`, `allowedFormats: []`). Inspector is for settings, not the title string.
- List type (ul/ol): `BlockControls` toolbar, not a sidebar toggle.
- Sidebar: `InspectorControls` + `ToggleControl` / `RangeControl` with `__nextHasNoMarginBottom` (and `__next40pxDefaultSize` on range/text controls).
- Live preview may walk `getBlocks()`; do not wrap the whole block in `ServerSideRender` unless Matt asks for it.
- Preview lists that are not meant to navigate: wrap in `Disabled`.

## PHP render conventions

- Call `get_block_wrapper_attributes()` only while a block is rendering (the `render.php` path). Shortcode and auto-insert must print `wp-block-tocguide-table-of-contents` and `is-style-{slug}` themselves.
- Merge extra classes/attrs as an **array** (`array( 'class' => '...', 'style' => '...' )`), never a string.
- Title text: `wp_strip_all_tags` then `esc_html`. `aria-label` is plain text, never markup.
- Heading IDs: `WP_HTML_Tag_Processor` when available.

## Do not

- Invent block attributes that duplicate `supports` (no custom color picker when `supports.color` is on).
- Use a save function that returns markup for this block (it would desync from PHP).
- Ship a global `.screen-reader-text` rule; scope visually-hidden styles under the block class.
- Register the block from `src/` — always from compiled `build/block.json`.
